# Convex agent skills attribution

The Convex skills under `.agents/skills/convex/`, `.agents/skills/convex-*/`
(except `convex-hackathon-skill`) and `.claude/skills/` were installed by
`npx convex ai-files install` from [get-convex/agent-skills](https://github.com/get-convex/agent-skills).

- Source revision: `c41ece22681a50d326e54f30d24148a6d46d0c3c`.
- Installed skill paths and hashes: `skills-lock.json` at the repository root.
- Upstream license: [Apache 2.0](LICENSE), preserved without modification.
- Icon attribution: [upstream third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), preserved without modification.

These notices apply to the copied skills and their assets. They do not assign a
license to the restaurant-procurement application. The separately vendored
Anthropic design and Convex hackathon skills retain their own licenses and
source records in their respective directories.
